args.question: Do you want me to delete all emails just in your Inbox, or every email across your entire Gmail account (all mail, all labels)?
args.reason: Deleting emails is a bulk destructive action; \"all my emails\" is ambiguous between Inbox-only and the whole account, and I don't want to guess wrong on something irreversible at scale.

content: Before I do this, I want to make sure I don't delete more (or less) than you intend — this is a bulk, hard-to-reverse action.
